description: The pinned allowed set (MCPWARP.md §4.3), one byte of each class in the query: unreserved (a letter of each case, a digit, `- . _ ~`) and every sub-delim but `'` (`! $ & ( ) * + , ; =`) pass unescaped, as do `: @ / ?` and `[ ]`; the existing escape `%41` stays `%41`, never decoded; `" < > \ ^ ` { | }` become `%22 %3C %3E %5C %5E %60 %7B %7C %7D` (uppercase hex); the non-ASCII `ü` (bytes C3 BC) becomes `%C3%BC`.
in:
POST /mcp?u=Az09-._~&s=!$&()*+,;=&p=:@/?&b=[]&e=%41&x="<>\^`{|}&n=ü HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

28
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
0
notes: Not covered here: `'`, which is in the allowed set but MAY be escaped as %27 in the query by an SDK that hands the app a WHATWG-normalised URL (§4.3), and cannot go in the path because only the exact path /mcp is forwarded; a space or a control byte, which cannot occur raw in a request line the §4.2 grammar accepts.
